_comment: Hand-written `simp-trace-v1` fixtures for the renderer unit tests.
Every case is written from tracking/SIMP-TRACE-SPEC.md, NOT from the current
recorder output. Where the recorder deviates from the spec, the spec wins here
and the deviation is reported as a T1 defect; the renderer must not be shaped
around a defect it would then hide.
`expect` is the exact `explicit_rw` text the step or trace must render as.
`error` is the RenderError reason a malformed field must raise, with the side

steps.name: rw_plain_fwd
steps.why: spec STEP `rw`: name, position, forward direction

steps.name: rw_rev
steps.why: spec `dir: rev` is the `←` direction

steps.name: rw_root_position
steps.why: spec: `[]` is the whole location

steps.name: rw_args_atomic
steps.why: spec `args`: explicit argument terms, applied to the name

steps.name: rw_args_compound_parenthesised
steps.why: a compound argument must be parenthesised or application misbinds

steps.name: rw_prop_true
steps.why: spec: a Prop-valued fact used as `p = True` replays as `eq_true name`

steps.name: rw_prop_false
steps.why: spec: `¬p` used as `p = False` replays as `eq_false name`

steps.name: rw_prop_with_args
steps.why: the prop wrapper applies to the name, the args to the wrapped term

steps.name: rw_side_rfl
steps.why: spec `side`: one nested trace per hypothesis of a conditional lemma

steps.name: rw_side_with_steps
steps.why: a side trace with steps renders as a nested explicit_rw plus its close
steps.expect: if_pos at [0] with [explicit_rw [eq_true hP at []] then rfl]

steps.name: rw_side_intros
steps.why: spec: an implication-shaped hypothesis carries `intros` on its side trace
steps.expect: ite_congr at [] with [rfl, intro_ref 0 ; explicit_rw [hx at [0]] then rfl]

steps.name: rw_side_omega
steps.why: spec: a side discharged by the user's `omega` discharger

steps.name: rw_side_nofun
steps.why: spec: `nofun` is the close for reduceCtorEq-style side conditions

steps.name: rw_local_named
steps.why: an accessible local is written as its plain user name

steps.name: rw_source_provenance_ignored
steps.why: spec: `source` is provenance only and has no syntax

steps.name: unfold_step
steps.why: spec STEP `unfold`: delta-unfold one constant

step.name: Function.Injective
step.after: ∀ a b, f a = f b → a = b

steps.name: beta_step
steps.why: spec STEP `beta`

steps.name: eta_step
steps.why: spec STEP `eta`

steps.name: proj_step
steps.why: spec STEP `proj`: structure projection reduction

steps.name: zeta_step
steps.why: spec STEP `zeta`: `let x := v; b` to `b[v/x]`

steps.name: zeta_delta_local_definition
steps.why: recorder-shaped zetaDelta event from the zeta_delta_at_hyp fixture: local fvar g unfolds to its value before the following beta step

steps.name: iota_step
steps.why: spec STEP `iota`: matcher/recursor on a constructor, one step

steps.name: change_step
steps.why: spec STEP `change`: definitional replacement checked by defeq

steps.name: change_dsimproc
steps.why: spec: a dsimproc firing is a `change` with `source`, never an `eq`

steps.name: eq_step_rfl
steps.why: spec STEP `eq`: a simproc equation proved by an ordinary tactic

steps.name: eq_step_decide
steps.why: spec: `by` is exactly `rfl` or `decide`
steps.expect: eq ((2 : ℕ) < 5 = True) by decide at []

steps.name: congr_step
steps.why: spec STEP `congr`: dependent congruence with nested steps

steps.name: congr_nested
steps.why: T2's grammar nests congr two levels; T1's congr_nested_cast needs it

steps.name: congr_with_reduction
steps.why: nested steps are ordinary steps of any innermost kind
steps.expect: congr 0 [beta at [1], unfold f at []] at [1]

steps.name: change_universe_annotations
steps.why: renderer preserves the exact trace text; fresh recorder output hides universes
steps.expect: change Prod.{u_1, u_2} α α' at []

steps.name: change_string_with_universe_like_text
steps.why: universe-like punctuation inside an ordinary string literal is preserved exactly

steps.name: dependent_forall_transport
steps.why: T35 records the exact binder handle and child-rooted domain/body steps
steps.expect: transport forall 4 [hA at []] body [hB at [0]] at [0, 1]

steps.name: intro_ctx_stable_metadata
steps.why: T34 stable handle/domain/dependency/scope metadata renders through T33 syntax
steps.expect: intro_ctx 0 domain at [0, 1, 1, 1, 0] deps [1, 8, 5] scope 0 enter at [0, 1, 1, 1] exit at [0, 1, 1, 1] with [Function.update_of_ne (introduced_ref 0) at [1]] at [0, 1, 1, 1]

steps.name: intro_ctx_contextual_local_handle
steps.why: T34 local evidence carries the stable handle through a side trace
steps.expect: intro_ctx 0 domain at [0, 0] deps [] scope 0 enter at [0] exit at [0] with [hiff at [1] with [explicit_rw [prop_false (introduced_ref 0) at []] then rfl]] at [0]

step_errors.name: unknown_kind_is_hard_error
step_errors.why: spec: unknown `kind` values are a hard error for the replay tactic

step_errors.name: intro_ctx_display_name_refused
step_errors.why: stable T34 metadata must never fall back to an inaccessible display name

step_errors.name: intro_ctx_missing_metadata
step_errors.why: T33 syntax cannot be guessed from an unstructured contextual step

step_errors.name: intro_ctx_nested_structural_step
step_errors.why: T33's inner grammar excludes recursive structural steps

step_errors.name: contextual_local_missing_stable_handle
step_errors.why: a contextual local without T34's handle must remain visibly unresolved

step_errors.name: name_is_written_syntax
step_errors.why: T1 defect: `name` must be a name, not a term (REVIEW-9 defect 2)

step_errors.name: name_named_argument_is_syntax
step_errors.why: T1 defect: `heq_comm (a := a)` is syntax in a name field

step_errors.name: inaccessible_display_name
step_errors.why: T1 defect: `a✝` does not lex (REVIEW-9 defect 3a)

step_errors.name: hygienic_name
step_errors.why: T1 defect: a raw hygienic name is not a user name (REVIEW-9 defect 3b)

step_errors.name: transport_bad_handle
step_errors.why: T35 handle is a stable non-negative integer

step_errors.name: transport_nested_not_inner
step_errors.why: T2's inner-step grammar does not admit recursive transport

step_errors.name: args_elided
step_errors.why: T1 defect: `⋯` is pretty-printer elision, not a term

step_errors.name: change_to_has_telescope
step_errors.why: T1 defect: `change.to` with `have` syntax (REVIEW-9 defect 7)

step.to:
have x : Nat := a;
f (@HAdd.hAdd Nat Nat Nat inst a b)

step_errors.name: change_to_pp_all
step_errors.why: T2 dialect gap: universes and nat_lit are outside the term grammar

step_errors.name: zeta_delta_missing_target
step_errors.why: a named zeta event must carry its recorded post-reduction expression

step_errors.name: zeta_delta_invalid_name
step_errors.why: a named zeta event must retain a valid local-name provenance field

step_errors.name: beta_with_name
step_errors.why: only the recorder's zetaDelta event defines a reduction name

step_errors.name: bad_direction
step_errors.why: `dir` is exactly fwd or rev

step_errors.name: bad_prop_value
step_errors.why: `prop` is exactly the strings true or false

step_errors.name: bad_eq_by
step_errors.why: spec: `eq.by` is exactly rfl or decide

step_errors.name: bad_position
step_errors.why: POS is a list of child indices

step_errors.name: side_with_by_block
step_errors.why: T2 rejects every term containing a `by` block

step_errors.name: empty_side_trace
step_errors.why: a side with neither steps nor a close discharges nothing

traces.name: zeta_delta_at_hyp_trace
traces.why: the exact named-zeta then beta sequence from test/SimpTrace/zeta_delta_at_hyp renders as the corresponding explicit_rw steps
expect: explicit_rw [change (fun s => s + 0) at [1, 0], beta at [1]] at hg

traces.name: goal_location
traces.why: a goal location renders as one explicit_rw with a `then` closer

traces.name: hypothesis_location
traces.why: spec `{"hyp": n}` renders as the tactic's `at h` location clause

traces.name: hypothesis_close_absurd
traces.why: a hypothesis rewrite is followed by the exact goal closer as an ordinary tactic
expect: explicit_rw [foo at []] at h; explicit_rw [] then close [h.elim]

traces.name: hypothesis_close_assumption
traces.why: a recorded assumption closer follows the hypothesis rewrite without guessing
expect: explicit_rw [foo at []] at h; explicit_rw [] then close [h]

traces.name: hypothesis_close_true_intro
traces.why: true_intro uses the same exact close mapping after a hypothesis rewrite
expect: explicit_rw [foo at []] at h; explicit_rw [] then close [True.intro]

traces.name: hypothesis_close_rfl
traces.why: rfl uses the same exact close mapping after a hypothesis rewrite
expect: explicit_rw [foo at []] at h; explicit_rw [] then rfl

traces.name: multi_location
traces.why: spec: `at h ⊢` and `at *` become one explicit_rw per location, in order

traces.name: multi_location_terminal_hypothesis_close
traces.why: non-closing locations run first, and the unique hypothesis closer is last
expect: explicit_rw [bar at []] at h2; explicit_rw [] then close [h2.elim]

traces.name: no_close_leaves_goal_open
traces.why: spec: `close: null` means the goal stays open, so no `then` clause

traces.name: main_goal_close_delimiter
traces.why: the main goal closer is bracket-delimited in the rendered explicit_rw call

unresolved.name: unresolved_discharger
unresolved.why: spec: a non-simp discharger is a classified unresolved outcome

unresolved.name: unresolved_simproc
unresolved.why: spec: a simproc proof that is neither rfl/decide nor one lemma

unresolved.name: resolved_trace_has_no_reason
unresolved.why: a clean trace must not be reported unresolved

inaccessible.name: collects_ctx_indices_sorted
inaccessible.why: spec: rename_i names come from the order of inaccessible declarations
